title: Edge latency steering using p50/p95 telemetry and network health scoring
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design and implement an edge-aware region selection controller that uses rolling p50/p95 latency telemetry combined with a multi-signal network health score to steer requests to the best region and to decide tier routing and fallback model variants. Goals: (1) reduce tail latency for latency-sensitive routes without increasing cost disproportionately; (2) provide predictable failover to compatible model variants (quantized/smaller) during regional degradation; (3) expose explainable routing decisions in Console and logs for debugging and audits. Acceptance criteria: telemetry pipeline emits per-region p50/p95 histograms and EMAs; region selector computes composite score (latency + health + capacity) and prefers lower-scoring regions for gold-tier traffic; fallback mapping table routes to model-variant ids when composite score > threshold; canary rollout completed with no customer-facing errors and p95 improvement >= 10% for targeted routes.
